title: THE LANDLORD WHO SOLD THE QUIET
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: The smallest-scale candidate has immediate embodied stakes, a coherent but culpable ordinary counterpart, a specific physical discovery and room for sharp dialogue in which accountability does not erase the building's real financial risk. It gives the day an intimate opening rather than beginning with spectacle. Risk: The acoustics and lease solution could become a tidy technical demonstration, while the seizure-prone child risks functioning only as moral leverage and Venn could collapse into a convenient corrupt landlord.

R14 check before prose. Aim: end the pulse that triggers Pia Rask's seizures without pretending the ring's air bill is imaginary. Counterpart: Sel Venn (afraid of default, a real sum on one side of the page; he hid the surcharge and read his own sensor flags as noise) and Marit Osei (Quiet-tier tenant who legitimately paid for silence). Strongest objection on the page: Venn's air-contract arithmetic (scene 2) and Marit's refusal to give up her wife's quiet (scene 3). What Illuminara must understand: the pulse is a beat between two notes that meet only at one junction, and the 'damped path' map predates the hall (Pia's counting supplies the clue; Marit supplies the dating; the mallet test corrects Illuminara's own first prediction). Love in action: she stays through the seizure night holding the bed plate (a cost, not a solution), asks Venn for the version of the ledger that frightens him instead of shaming him, offers him a path that keeps hall and building, and does not ask Odd to forgive anyone. Freely chosen change: Venn comes to the cavity alone, feels the pulse in his palm, and speaks first at the residents' meeting; residents vote and amend (Marit's amendment makes quiet a floor rather than a product). Concrete result: Cavity Nine unsealed, seven verified quiet nights including three concert nights, dampers funded by the Cycle gate, equal night floor in every lease, audited resident seats, surcharge repaid. Felt moment of her own: being used as a railing by a frightened child (scene 1) and hearing the concert as music for the first time (scene 6). Power appears as protection only (bed plate, then the flange held true for forty minutes) and decides nothing. Open for the critic: the beat-frequency idea is…

A strong, humane first draft with unusually clean agency. Pia's counting, Odd's refusal to forgive, Marit's technical independence and Venn's real fear of default all matter; Illuminara protects people, investigates, admits a wrong prediction and leaves the binding decision to residents. The seven verified quiet nights, lease floor, repayment and resident keys make the positive result concrete. Three causal gaps remain: the acoustic proof does not yet identify the second oscillator promised by Pia's clue, the new ledger does not yet answer Venn's air-bill objection after quiet stops being a premium product, and Venn's costly public choice is compressed between feeling the wall and accepting the whole package.

R14 check before revision. Aim unchanged: end the pulse that triggers Pia's seizures while keeping air and solvency for the whole ring. Counterparts: Venn (default fear, culpable concealment) and Marit (legitimate quiet). Strongest objection on the page: the sixty-two-percent air bill, now answered with post-change arithmetic and a contested contingency. What Illuminara learns and how it changes the intervention: the hush plates are resonators as well as walls; the pulse is thirty-six against twenty-nine; dampers go into the cavity tuned to twenty-nine. Love in action: she sends Pia out of the test, asks for the frightening ledger, holds the flange true, and never asks Odd to forgive. Freely chosen change: Venn posts his notice at noon with the outcome unknown; residents author the covenant, the contingency and the floor. Power appears as protection only (bed plate, flange) and decides nothing. Word count is about 2,800 by a count that includes speaker labels, over the usual 2,500 norm because three causal repairs were requested; I trimmed about 150 words elsewhere to offset.

The revision materially resolves all three T02 priorities. The three-run acoustic proof now distinguishes the hall resonance, plate response and seven-hertz beat; the before/after ledger makes the trade legible and preserves a resident contingency; and Venn discloses the ignored flags and surcharge ledger before the vote, loses nine tenants and refuses a cleansing apology. The story now has a strong causal spine, costly love in action, voluntary resident choice and a concrete positive result. Three bounded continuity/accounting points remain before final; none requires a structural rewrite or another full review round.

R14 check before final. Aim unchanged: end the pulse that triggers Pia's seizures while keeping air and solvency for the whole ring. Outcome (3a): seven quiet nights including three concert nights, resident audit power, reserve and contingency, a funded permanent damper repair, and a conditionally secured air renewal, all made possible by Illuminara's wrong-then-corrected reading of Pia's count, her demand for Venn's frightening ledger and her proposal of the three-run test; others author the covenant, floor and contingency and keep the right to leave. Remaining costs stated on the page: six-week hall closure, Venn's lost sole signature, two tenants gone, an unsigned renewal behind a deposit. Power appears as protection only (bed plate, flange) and decides nothing. Word count about 2,960 including speaker labels and markdown marks, over the usual norm because three causal repairs and three accounting fixes were requested across two rounds.

The final resolves all three T04 priority points materially and without introducing a new blocker. THE LANDLORD WHO SOLD THE QUIET is ready for the source-bound Slovenian translation and the two genuine separately locked READER_APPEAL_R1 final-reader judgments.

final_critic_line: Illuminara traces a child's seven-count pulse to two systems that are harmless alone but harmful together, then helps residents replace purchased quiet with a tested repair, open accounts and a freely chosen covenant that preserves both sleep and air.

evaluation.note: Both genuine isolated judgments were locked to the exact English final before the metadata-only DAY_FREEZE; the publisher opened them only after that freeze.
